source: A review for engineering teams compared six runs. Parser warnings first appeared in rendering in four runs and in ingestion in two. This locates visible warnings, not their internal cause. For the next selected failure, the review requires inspection of its actual preceding input and the earliest supported boundary before choosing an intervention. It does not rank expected payoffs.

idea.title: Fix rendering first for the greatest immediate reduction in warnings
idea.description: Explain the four rendering and two ingestion observations and the requirement to inspect the preceding input before intervention choice.
idea.rationale: Rendering recurrence makes it a plausible area of interest, while the chosen failure and actual input determine the intervention boundary.
idea.evidence: Four rendering cases, two ingestion cases; no cause or payoff ranking.
